description: Read a local PDF/DOC/DOCX/TXT resume and return its plain text, optionally also parsing it into structured JSON (name, experience, education, skills). Text extraction is unlimited; set structured=true only when the structured form is needed, since that path uses a daily AI credit. Scanned/image-only PDFs will fail — ask the user to paste the text instead.

filePath.description: Path to the resume file on this machine (absolute, or relative to the CWD).

structured.description: Also return AI-parsed structured resume JSON. Costs one daily AI credit. Defaults to false.

name: extract_resume_text
title: Extract plain text from a local resume file
